Vinícius Wilbert Hack (Vinícius Hack) has been a hired developer since 2021 and, on the side, builds his own apps and apps for clients. What he cares about is the path: sit with the problem, pick the right tool, and ship something people actually use — that also creates business value.

## Work

- Automatize — AI agent so a non-technical client can create, pause and read paid-traffic campaigns in the app and WhatsApp
- Layback Trading — white-label trading platform (100k+ users/day), NestJS APIs and Rust bot engine
- MyTribe — iOS/Android social app
- Your Daily Cards — mobile app
- Alento Foto & Filme — wedding photography site, freelance from scratch to paying clients
- Goalfy — Stripe payments and react-flow diagrams

## Location

Balneário Camboriú, SC, Brazil. Languages: Portuguese and English.
